name: Valero Market
kind: Grocery marketplace · black editorial food hall
summary: The molino grocery marketplace as an after-dark food hall: a black page with ivory type and champagne hairlines, an editorial hero, the aisles as a numbered index, hairline grids of cards on ivory wells, a split product page with the sellers as a table, a full-height bag panel, a numbered checkout, makers' pages and a magazine-style journal.
